objectives.label: At most 125 m³ per person fed

achievements.title: First Sprout
achievements.about: Grow a round of trial plots and compare every harvest with its prediction.
achievements.evidence: 10 trial plots grown; 8 predictions held, 2 missed.

achievements.title: Adaptive Intelligence
achievements.about: Validate an RL irrigation policy on held-out seasons, deploy it, and finish within the water quota.
achievements.evidence: Policy deployed; season used 54,384 m³ of a quota.

achievements.title: Scientific Detective
achievements.about: Detect a hidden fault and identify its true cause from field evidence.
achievements.evidence: Clogged drip line in F4 on day 95; detected on day 118 and identified by test.

achievements.title: Resilience Architect
achievements.about: Recover from a fault: repair it or correct the model, and still meet the plan's bad-year projection.
achievements.evidence: 457.5 people fed against a bad-year projection of 417.3, after a clogged drip line.

achievements.title: Water Steward
achievements.about: Finish a season within the quota using at most 125 m³ of groundwater per person fed.
achievements.evidence: 118.9 m³ of groundwater per person fed, within the quota.

achievements.title: Harvest Guardian
achievements.about: Feed at least 450 people from one season.
achievements.evidence: 457.5 people fed.
